note: One full survey of the released go-perl v0.3.0 on the CPAN snapshot of 2026-11-20, and the static builds of what passed with gperl v0.3.1. The results of perl itself are from the snapshot of 2026-11-10, joined with these by distribution name.
network: The phases up to the build reach the internet, but not private, link-local or shared address space, the machine that runs the containers or its host; DNS goes only to the resolver Docker gives the containers. The test phase runs with no network but loopback.

static.environment: The binary runs in a container whose image holds no file at all: no C library, no perl, no /etc/passwd, no time zones, no certificates. It gets a writable tmpfs /tmp of 1 GiB (the binary unpacks its program and the standard library there; without a writable temporary directory no gperl binary starts), no network, user 65534 without capabilities, a read-only root file system, 1500 MiB of memory, and 120 seconds.
